questions.question: The graph of y = (4x - 32)(x + 6) is a parabola in the xy-plane. In which of the following equivalent equations do the x- and y-coordinates of the vertex of the parabola appear as constants or coefficients?
questions.explanation: Vertex form is needed. The x-coordinate of the vertex is the midpoint of the roots, (8 + (-6))/2 = 1, and y = -196 there, so y = 4(x - 1)^2 - 196.
